title: fix(app-shell,i18n): the Organization flows page says each draft publishes by itself, and a deep-link miss shows no false "no designers" notice (objectui#11591)
body:
Fixes #11591
Clause-②: no

Implemented by an os-dev run of the PM claim on the card (branch `claude/issue-11591-org-flows-copy`, session `https://claude.ai/code/session_01FjqrwXPfSMkSfkKYDSRkN2`).

## What changed

### 1. The package-less sheet no longer claims atomicity

- `DraftChangesPanel`'s confirm note reads `preview.changes.confirmNote` when the panel has a `packageId` (unchanged, byte for byte, in all ten packs) and the new `preview.changes.confirmNoteSeparate` when it has none.
- Why `packageId` decides: only a package has a batch door (`POST /packages/:id/publish-drafts`). The package-less page's Publish (the `packageId === null` branch of `doPublish` in `StudioDesignSurface`) calls `publishDraft` once per draft and keeps going past a failure, so a partial publish is possible there.
- The new family is in all ten packs, with each pack's own CLDR categories plus the base key and the en parity slots: en/de one+other, es/fr/pt one+many+other, ru one+few+many+other, ar zero through other, ja/ko/zh other. en reads:
  - one: "Publishing releases the 1 pending draft on its own: if it fails, it stays pending."
  - other: "Publishing releases the 2 pending drafts one at a time: a draft that fails stays pending while the others go live."
- The panel's other host, the draft-preview bar, passes neither `packageId` nor `onPublish`. It renders no confirm footer and does not change.

### 2. A deep-link miss and an empty list show no false "no designers" notice

- `AutomationsPillar` read `getMetadataPreview(current?.type ?? '')`. With no flow open, that read is for the type `''`, which returns undefined. `isEditable` was then false, and the canvas chip rendered `engine.studio.auto.designersMissing` ("No metadata designers are registered in this session…") next to the correct miss sentence.
- It now reads `getMetadataPreview('flow')`, the pillar's one type, the same way the `getMetadataInspector('flow')` read beside it already worked. Nothing changes with a flow open, because every rail entry of this pillar has the type `flow`.
- The notice still keys on the registry: where no designer is registered, it still shows with no flow open (pinned below).
- `views/metadata-admin/**` is not edited (objectui#10202 holds it). The copy keys already existed.

## Measured

All at `67dcfcb` unless said otherwise.

**Red before the fix** (tests written first, run on the unfixed tree): 15 failed, 41 passed across the 4 pin files. The received strings were:
- package-less sheet, 1 draft: "Publishing releases the 1 pending draft of this package atomically."
- package-less sheet, 2 drafts: "Publishing releases all 2 pending drafts of this package atomically."
- `/studio/~org/automations?surface=flow:showcase_urgent_task_alert` (the card's measured URL): the page text held "No metadata designers are registered in this session, so this flow cannot be designed here." beside "The link names flow “showcase_urgent_task_alert”, which is not here."
- The same on a package page's miss.
- An empty package-less list: the measurement the card predicted. The rail's "No flows outside a package yet. …" sat beside the same false notice.
- ten packs: no `confirmNoteSeparate` family.

**Green after the fix**: `pnpm exec vitest run` on the 4 pin files gave 4 files, 56 of 56 tests passed.

**Ablations.** Each one went through `ablation-replace.mjs`, which checks that the anchor hit once and that the blob changed. Each was restored by blob hash with `git diff HEAD` empty:
- The atomic sentence back on the package-less path (the note's condition forced to `true`): 2 failed, 2 passed. The two package-less cases failed and received the atomic sentence. The two package-sheet controls stayed green.
- The notice keyed on the selection again (`getMetadataPreview(current?.type ?? '')`): 3 failed, 18 passed. The failures were the measured miss, the package page's miss and the empty list. The control with a flow open stayed green. So did the empty-registry case, because with no designer registered the notice shows either way, which is the direction expected.
- The ja package-less form given the package sentence's "まとめて（アトミックに）": 1 failed, 30 passed. Only ja failed.

**Wider runs.**
- `packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/` and `packages/app-shell/src/preview/`: 103 files, 653 tests passed.
- `packages/i18n/`, plus every test that reads a changed file as source text: 117 files, 2663 passed and 13 skipped. These tests were found by grepping test sources for `readFileSync` and `?raw`, and for the names `StudioDesignSurface.tsx`, `DraftChangesPanel.tsx` and `locales/*.ts`. They are `packages/app-shell/src/__tests__/`, `ObjectView.viewConfigGate`, the metadata-admin i18n tests, `HomeItemTypeLabel.parity`, `apiErrorEnvelope` and the `scripts/__tests__` suites for the i18n gates, node-esm-load, eager-closure, eager-locale-catalogues, spec-symbol ledger and derivation, one-authority, vi-mock-inherit, side-effects, self-import and turbo build outputs.

**Type-check.** `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check` and `pnpm --filter @object-ui/i18n type-check` both exited 0. They ran after `pnpm turbo run build --filter='@object-ui/app-shell^...'` (28 of 28 tasks). Both test tsconfigs list the new test files; this was checked with `--listFilesOnly`.

**Gates, all exit 0.** The gates run were:
- the i18n gates: `check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-drift` ("No en value changed in this range"), `check:i18n-dead-keys` (the new keys are not candidates) and `check:i18n-designer-parity`;
- the named file gates: `check:control-bytes`, `check:new-line-citations` (0 new) and `check:changeset-claims`;
- the test and mock gates: `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:vi-mock-inherit`, `check:vi-mock-override-shape` and `check:vi-mock-specifiers`;
- the source gates: `check:spec-symbols`, `check:metadata-write-doors`, `check:handler-key-reads`, `check:esm-specifiers`, `check:unreferenced-sources`, `check:self-import` and `check:phantom-deps`;
- the changeset gates: `scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` and `changeset:check`.

**Lint (narrowed, not the repo-wide run).**
- `eslint --format json` ran on the 16 changed `.ts`/`.tsx` files; the JSON output has 16 results. It reported 0 errors.
- The two changed sources carry 2 and 17 warnings. The rule multisets are identical to those of the same two files at the base `2e818d0`. The base files were linted in place and then restored by blob hash.
- `eslint.config.js` sets no `parserOptions.project` and no `projectService`, so linting is not type-aware. This diff therefore cannot move a verdict in a file it does not touch.

**NOT MEASURED** (left to CI):
- `check:eager-closure` / `check:eager-locale-catalogues`: they need a console build. The en pack is in the eager closure, and this adds three en strings.
- `pnpm test` (all 8 shards).
- `pnpm lint`.

## Acceptance notes

- With no flow open, the pillar's other text is unchanged. The chip now reads its standing "Visual orchestration · click a node to configure". The canvas reads "Select an automation" on an empty list. The configuration panel reads "Click a node on the canvas, and its configuration appears here." The card's pin is the false notice. These are observations, and nothing was filed for them.
- In en, de, es, fr and pt, the single-draft form does not mention "the others", because a partial publish needs at least two drafts. ru's `one` category also covers 21, 31 and so on, so its one-form avoids "the others" too. ar, ja, ko and zh use one sentence for every count, as their `confirmNote` does.
- Changeset `.changeset/11591-org-flows-copy.md`: `@object-ui/app-shell` patch, `@object-ui/i18n` patch.
